anchor.surface_text: The Court’s task in exercising its supervisory function is not to take the place of the competent domestic courts but rather to review under Article 10 the decisions they have taken pursuant to their power of appreciation. In particular, the Court must determine whether the reasons adduced by the national authorities to justify the interference were “relevant and sufficient” and whether the measure taken was “proportionate to the legitimate aims pursued”.

concepts.interpretation: The Court reviewed the domestic courts' decisions for relevant and sufficient reasons and proportionality, without substituting its own judgment.
